channel.title: SIREN — level changes only
channel.description: Every AI doom number is a judgement call. This one is arithmetic: how much is happening in AI, measured hourly from public data — not how bad it is. Five pillars, one 0-100 score, one level from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest), and every number reproducible from a published receipt.

item.title: SIREN 4 → SIREN 4: ROUTINE
item.description: Score 40.9 to 40.9 (±0.0) at 2026-09-23 20:04:22 UTC. SIREN measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
